title: Lazerz' SMP Essentials
description: Boost your FPS and sharpen your gameplay with this lightweight performance pack built just for multiplayer. It uses the best speed mods available to keep your game responsive and smooth. Created by LordLazerz
body: Boost your FPS and sharpen your gameplay with this lightweight performance pack built just for multiplayer. It uses the best speed mods available to keep your game responsive and smooth during intense PVP encounters and player interactions. It works entirely on your own computer, meaning you can join any server without the host needing to install a thing. Grab it now for a competitive edge every time you PVP with friends! Modpack was put together by LordLazerz
